spans.s:
शौधिका शौधिका, f. a variety of panic,
(Panicum Italicum, = रक्त-कङ्गु.)

सौध सौध, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. सुधा), relating
or belonging to nectar, having nectar; having plaster;
plastered, stuccoed; (अस्), m. a kind of plant, =
दुग्ध-पाषाण; (अम्), n. a plastered or white-
washed mansion; any great mansion or house; a
palace, (also अस्, m. according to some); silver;
opal (according to some).
—सौध-कार, अस्, m. a
plasterer, whitewasher; the builder or maker of a
palace.
—सौध-वास, अस्, m. a palatial dwelling.

सौधन्य सौधन्य, अस्, &c. (probably fr.
सु-धन), epithet of certain Dharmāḥ or laws.

सौधन्वन सौधन्वन, अस्, m. (fr. सु-धन्-
वन्), a son or descendant of Su-dhanvan.

सौधातकि सौधातकि, इस्, m. (fr. सु-धातृ),
a patronymic, (Pāṇ.

); N. of a hermit
(pupil of Vālmīki).

सौधार सौधार, अस्, m. (according to
some) one of the fourteen parts or divisions of a
drama, (a doubtful word.)

सौधाल सौधाल, अम्, n. (probably to be
connected with सौध, p. 1138), a temple of Śiva.
